title: Sustained Release Channel Ops and Cross-Surface Compatibility Matrix
creator: Miguel Ortega
description: Purpose: define a practical, auditable matrix and operational playbook that ties Redwood's sustained (long-lived) release channels to concrete compatibility guarantees across runtime, public API, official SDKs, and Console. Scope: runtime binary/ABI compatibility, inference API schema stability, SDK surface/backwards compatibility, Console UI/API compatibility, upgrade tooling, rollout gates, deprecation windows, and observability to detect regressions. Goals: 1) produce a one-page support matrix mapping channel -> supported versions for each surface, 2) establish automated pre-rollout checks and blocking gates, 3) identify minimal compatibility contracts (what _must_ be stable vs what can be opt-in breaking), 4) design upgrade automation (canary, staged, emergency rollback), 5) surface clear migration notes and deprecation timelines to customers and internal teams. Non-goals: redefine semantic versioning across all repos (we will align but not force immediate renames) and implement full cross-product compatibility tests in this ticket (that is follow-up).
